initial_application: Commit 369fa26519 added NutritionOrder.groupIdentifier and the NutritionOrder-group-identifier token SearchParameter. Follow-up commit 922aa67c96 corrected the search parameter path and expression to NutritionOrder.groupIdentifier, and the work was merged in e78a90027f.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes nutritionorder=NutritionOrder. FHIR-36664 had earlier left groupIdentifier for future consideration; FHIR-37965 is the targeted final decision to add it. FHIR-43447 later reviewed NutritionOrder workflow-pattern alignment and still listed groupIdentifier mapped to Request.groupIdentifier. FHIR-49437 is broader common pattern search-parameter work in Resolved - change required state and does not supersede this applied NutritionOrder-specific search parameter.

The combined branch contains the same source state.
